description: This file contains functions and procedures for managing NAND flash memory upgrades in OpenWrt, including identifying, formatting, and restoring NAND partitions, as well as handling different image types for system upgrades.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume based on directory info.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds a NAND volume by name within a UBI device.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device associated with a given partition.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads magic number from a NAND device.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Reads magic number from a tar archive.

methods.name: identify_magic
methods.description: Identifies the type of image based on magic number.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the image type of a NAND device.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the image type within a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from a backup tar to NAND.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI partition for upgrade, creating volumes.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Finalizes upgrade, restores config, and reboots.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Flashes a UBI image to NAND.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Writes a UBIFS image to UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Handles upgrade from a tar archive containing kernel and root filesystem.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to determine image type and perform upgrade.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is valid for NAND upgrade.
